profile.headline: Staff iOS Software Engineer at Coupang
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a wide variety of experience building client side applications currently focusing on iOS development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- iOS development lead on a team of two other iOS developers.
- Lead defining the development and testing workflows for a new team.
- Designed the iOS feature architecture of the new in app digital good purchases.
- Core member of the team that defined publicly exposed APIs for third party developers.
- Worked closely with product managers and designers to continuously ship features and bug fixes.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · Objective-C · TypeScript · iOS development · Apple Pay · Augmented Reality (AR) · BUCK · Bazel · Reactive Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead re-architecting efforts for the iOS application teams and worked closely with the Android team to work towards standard conventions across platforms.
- Created multiple internal frameworks to modularize major components and responsibilities of the application architecture.
- Implemented and scaled out across the team new unit testing strategies.
- Mentored other software engineers on the team on best practices, migrating legacy
code, and presented on newly released technologies, Combine, RxSwift, UICollectionViewDiffableDataSource, etc...
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · Objective-C · iOS development · Test Automation Frameworks · Unit Testing · Mentoring · Jenkins · UIKit · RxSwift · Apple Maps · Reactive Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead multiple re-architecting efforts throughout the core application code base for optimization purposes and code maintainability.
- Lead development of the company's flagship application’s widget (Today Extension).
- Contributor to internal SDKs written in Swift.
- Core member of the team that implemented integration with the company’s newest
Home IOT hub.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · Objective-C · iOS development · Internet of Things (IoT) · Home Automation · RxSwift · Reactive Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created formalized workflows for feature requests, UI designs, testing, releases, user analytics, and bug reports.
- Re-architected the existing flagship application to increased performance, decreased use
of system resources, and increased test coverage of code base.
- Migrated majority of iOS application’s Objective-C / Swift 2.3 code base to Swift 3.0.
- Setup infrastructure for automated unit, integration, and UI testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · Objective-C · iOS development · Unit Testing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Refactored and released the latest versions of the company's flagship iOS applications.
- Implemented advertisements system for flagship iOS application to support multiple ad
services.
- Managed localization pipelines for the company's iOS applications
- Feature development and bug fixes on iOS application.
positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · iOS development · Mobile Applications · Unit Testing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with product owners and designers to develop features.
- Created initial versions of iOS applications.
- Managed and collaborated with led overseas developers to release iOS applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · iOS development · Software Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Updated and maintained "DocuSign for Salesforce" application.
- Designed and developed internal automation tools ASP.NET and WPF.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · WPF · Apex Programming · .NET · ASP.NET

projects.title: Snapchat In-Lens Digital Goods
projects.description: Snapchat's In-Lens Digital Goods program allows third party lens developers to create digital content to enhance their lens experience and monetize off it.

projects.title: Redfin iOS Application
projects.description: Redfin's consumer iOS application.  A market place for real estate and rentals throughout the United States.
